notes.title: Update Notes Version v0.21.9.24
notes.notes:
Update Notes[olist]
Skill Adjustments

Fixed an issue where all 4 active skills dealt true damage.

Buff Fixes

Fixed an issue where player buffs were applied at full stacks immediately.

Fixed incorrect tooltip display when hovering the mouse over buffs.

Language & Display

Fixed incorrect language display in the English version.

Gameplay Adjustments

All 3 starting mechs are now unlocked from the beginning.

Miracle item exchange no longer costs 1000 Spirit Coins and is now free.

Leaderboard Fixes

Fixed issues with the Battlefield leaderboard.

Fixed issues with the Energy Tower leaderboard.

BD Recommendation System

Fixed an issue where switching recommended BD caused gems to be recycled.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Notes Version v0.10.7.22 (July 22, 2025)
notes.notes:
【Major Update Notes】

Active Skill System Overhaul
Each mech's active skills have been changed from 4 fixed skills to 2 freely swappable ones, greatly increasing build flexibility.

Starmap Gem Upgrade Optimization
Starmap gems can now be upgraded more intuitively through direct editing, improving ease of use.

Fusion Value Mechanic Adjustment
Before reaching 400 Fusion Value, all world monsters will no longer generate ground-based lingering debuffs, reducing early-game combat pressure.

New In-Game Guides
Additional tutorials and system guides have been added to help both new and returning players understand core mechanics more quickly.

Lowered Starmap Unlock Requirement
The requirement to fully unlock the starmap has been reduced from 400 Fusion Value to 200.

Visual Enhancements
Removed certain blood effects in maps that interfered with camera visibility, improving visual clarity and combat readability.

Battlefield Structure Simplification
The number of battlefield stages has been streamlined from 8 to 4, enhancing overall pacing and stage quality.

Energy Tower Bug Fix
Fixed an issue where Energy Tower layers could exceed 100 floors abnormally.
